description: CASEWORK C1 edited: the B24 widened to 27 in, every panel across the box 3 in longer (back 25.5, fronts 26.875, drawer box 24.5 wide), one door still: 3 820.10546875 in^3, 303.4375 in of banding, the same hardware. model.json is the plugin's expansion with the member materials documents applies; members.json each body's member metadata (packages/loft-plugins/tests/test_cabinets.py pins both).
derivation: Every expectation is ANALYTIC, from services/geometry/tests/test_casework.py's independent script of casework.md's conventions (spec(), C1 typed from its table), never from the plugin: each panel a box, a notched side its box less its 3 x 4.5 toe notch; summed in exact rational arithmetic (x 25.4 = mm exactly).
surface_area = each panel's box area, a notched side's less twice its notch's face; bodies are separate.
topology: a box 6 faces, 12 edges, 1 shell; a notched side 8 faces, 18 edges. MESH: a box 24 vertices and 12 triangles, a notched side 36 and 20 (two hexagons of 4 triangles, six quads of 2).
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill), 2026-10-23: volume 7.5e-9 mm^3 and area 9.3e-10 mm^2 off the exact sums over 15 bodies; 1e-7 is 13x the worst.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: Measured 2026-10-23: the STEP round trip re-sums the 15 re-imported solids in another order and moves the VOLUME by 1.1e-7 mm^3 (1.8e-15 relative), above ROUNDTRIP_TOL's 1e-7 absolute on a 6.3e7 mm^3 part, as the B2 walls' goldens. 5e-7 is 4.5x; volume and area only.
